signer_equivalence.same_live_operations: All three sites construct new signer from already paired test-owned ECDsa.Create(nistP256), then call CreateCredentialSlotAsync or CheckProviderSetupAsync. Kept getter hashes exported SPKI bytes directly. These overloads are not generally interchangeable on malformed keys. All current inputs are generated NISTP256 canonical SPKI; their values are equal.
